description: Channel access test data: Alex owns the channels, Morgan is an existing participant, Riley is a teammate excluded from the three request-test channels, and Sam is an outsider. Approval, denial, and cancellation have separate private channels so manual tests do not interfere. Public, team, already-member, and DM channels provide controls. No access requests are pre-created.

messages.text: Welcome to the channel access demo. Alex is the owner, Morgan is an existing member, Riley is a teammate without access to the request-test channels, and Sam is outside the team.
Use request-approve, request-deny, and request-cancel for independent test runs. Copy each private channel's link as Alex, then open it as Riley or Sam.
Approval test: Riley and Sam start without access. After an approval, the requester should be able to read this history and participate.
Existing members should retain access while someone else's request is pending. This message is visible only to participants.
Denial test: deny the request and confirm the requester still cannot read this channel's history or post messages.
Cancellation test: withdraw the request as Riley before the owner decides. Cancellation must not grant membership.
I am already a participant here. I should see the conversation and composer instead of an initial access-request screen.
Alex, Morgan, and Riley belong to Channel Access Demo. Sam does not. Team membership alone must not expose the private request-test channels.
Private DM control: this conversation is between Alex and Morgan only.
